gen-luckiest-guy-gf-noto-sans-tangsa: Loud, cheerful, poured-ink lettering from Luckiest Guy, with an e whose eye opens clearly to the right, sits over Noto Sans Tangsa. The body's wide, inviting round letters welcome a modest size.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-noto-sans-thai-loope: Fat, shouty, cheerful poured letters: Luckiest Guy leads. Noto Sans Thai Looped follows with sturdy-looking lowercase and spacious gaps at curve ends, so paragraphs of it read steadily without crowding.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-noto-sans-vai: Brash and bouncy, Luckiest Guy looks poured through a single nib, every stroke the same width. Noto Sans Vai turns words into solid blocks with generous space at curve ends, which steadies the shouting above.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-noto-sans-vithkuqi: Every stroke of Luckiest Guy looks bent from neon tube, loud and cheerful. Noto Sans Vithkuqi keeps open throats on a, c, e and s, so paragraphs of it run smooth and modern.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-noto-sans-wancho: Luckiest Guy keeps its strokes uniform in weight, cheerful and loud, while Noto Sans Wancho brings hulking, chalk-pressed lowercase. Paragraphs set in it feel sturdy and chunky, never fussy.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-numans: Luckiest Guy gives every stroke a pipe-like body, loud and cheerful. Numans lets its wide-tracked, rope-thick lowercase and far-hanging s drift across a whole paragraph at a leisurely pace.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-onest: Luckiest Guy looks poured at a single width, cheerful and loud. Onest, with short ascenders over big bowls and a gentle monotone line, makes paragraphs go down easily without ink pooling at the turns.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-preahvihear: Preahvihear opens its letter mouths like a pried oyster shell and stands on a lofty x-height. And Luckiest Guy shouts above it while paragraphs beneath stay spacious and easy to follow.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-puritan: Luckiest Guy cuts its stroke ends as if from one ribbon. Puritan brings rounded forms and oversized e and a counters, all clearly open to the side, which is where the pairing earns its warmth.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-radio-canada: Radio Canada reads cleanly, every curve left clearly open at its end. Luckiest Guy hollers above it in cheerful, uniform-width ink, and that shout-then-steady split is the pairing's whole appeal.
